mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in more than 30% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing sector and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market and robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output and overall economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals monetary tightening during a labor market slowdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE rising) fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in more than 30% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 260 (CPIAUCSL > 260), it signals high inflation and the expectation of Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
